Chas. and the late Harry Churcher and himself and brother Joe. In 1938 he dead-heated with brother Joe to win the National Junior 10 Miles (Garret Cup) Championship and with Colin Sutton (who was murdered by terrorists in Malaya) and Reg Elson to win the team title with a record breaking 16 points.
Bill joined the Club during 1935 when he came to Belgrave Hall to give a hand to his pal Charlie Churcher with the decorating, maintenance of the hall.
Regrettably Joe passed away on February 2nd 1988 aged 79. He joined the club in September 1939 being introduced by Chas.
